label: Begun populated pasts give metrically finite populated pasts
description: Strength order (linear time, any real clock): a past with a beginning is metrically finite, since in linear time the minimal moment lies at or before every moment and the clock is monotone. The converse fails in an open-below finite past (MetricGrimReaper control 2: positive real times, every populated past metrically finite, not every one begun). So founded, begun and metrically finite populated pasts form a strictly descending strength chain in linear time. No premise is established.
